# Subway Seat for Spotify (Spicetify)

Spicetify's color keys plus the whole palette as `--spice-*` variables, and a small user.css that turns Spotify's green accent into burnt orange and puts dark ink on its notification banners.

[Spotify (Spicetify)](https://spicetify.app) · [Previews and copy buttons](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/spicetify/)

## The quick way

```sh
curl -fsSL https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/install.sh | sh -s -- --only spicetify
```

The [installer](../../docs/INSTALL.md) shows its plan and asks once. Add `--flavor tunnel`, `--flavor enamel` or `--flavor auto` for another flavor. To do it yourself, use the files below.

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| All three | [`subway-seat/color.ini`](subway-seat/color.ini) | `~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/color.ini`; on Windows, %APPDATA%\spicetify\Themes\subway-seat\ |
| All three | [`subway-seat/user.css`](subway-seat/user.css) | `~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/user.css`; on Windows, %APPDATA%\spicetify\Themes\subway-seat\ |
| All three | [`manifest.json`](manifest.json) | for the Spicetify Marketplace: a copy belongs at the repository root, which its paths are relative to |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in a terminal, with the theme in Spicetify's Themes folder:

```sh
spicetify config current_theme subway-seat color_scheme walnut
spicetify apply
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in a terminal, with the theme in Spicetify's Themes folder:

```sh
spicetify config current_theme subway-seat color_scheme tunnel
spicetify apply
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in a terminal, with the theme in Spicetify's Themes folder:

```sh
spicetify config current_theme subway-seat color_scheme enamel
spicetify apply
```

## Uninstall

- Delete `~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/color.ini`.
- Delete `~/.config/spicetify/Themes/subway-seat/user.css`.
- Remove the line you added to turn it on.

Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py` (v0.3.0). Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
